source: A P2S/H2D-style push_status mid-print: no flat temperature floats at all. device.extruder.info[].temp, device.bed.info.temp and device.ctc.info.temp PACK current (low 16 bits) and target (high 16 bits) into one int (ha-bambulab models.py: 6553700 -> 100 / 100). Here 14418100 = nozzle 180 / 220, 3932219 = bed 59 / 60, 2621475 = chamber 35 / 40. The shop's own H2D fixture (h2d-device-observed-2026-09-09.json) carries the same layout with the heaters off (27 -> 27 / 0). No serial, no access code.
